resources.string: High-risk operations (payments, data changes) allowed with initial login assurance only. No step-up, no transaction binding, no server-side enforcement.
Payment requires fresh biometric before each transaction. Session token alone is insufficient \u2014 step-up assertion required.
Payment executed using only the session token from initial login. Stolen/leaked session = unauthorized transfers possible.
Transaction hash (amount + recipient + nonce) signed by Keystore key during biometric. Server verifies signature matches the exact transaction.
Single biometric approval can be reused for a different transaction. Attacker modifies the amount after approval \u2014 approval still valid.
Server requires a short-lived step-up token in addition to session token. No biometric assertion = API rejects with 403. Unpatchable by client.
Biometric shown only in app UI. Server accepts the regular session token without step-up assertion. APK patch skips the biometric entirely.
Low-risk ops (balance view) require session only. Medium (profile change) requires PIN. High (transfer) requires biometric + server step-up.
Login grants access to everything: balance view, fund transfer, profile change. Stolen session = full account control.
4. Same Session for All Risk Levels
